critique: The render has the correct basic glow-field ingredients—warm orange points, soft bloom, and a black background—but it is much too sparse and uneven to read as a cohesive field, especially at t1 where only a handful of isolated dots are visible. By t4 more particles appear, but the field is still scattered rather than richly populated; the visible density changes noticeably across just three frames, creating a build-up/popping impression instead of a stable animated glow texture. The largest glows are visually appealing but need more supporting particles around them.

suggestions.why: Increase emission density so the preset reads as a continuous luminous particle field from the first rendered frame and remains visually full across time.
Slightly enlarge the particle cores so the additional field density remains legible as soft glowing motes rather than mostly imperceptible pinpoints.
